AdmittedFinding.description: §3.5 — an obligation with an immutable id and its native source identity.
AdmittedFinding.title: AdmittedFinding

AnswerAction.description: §6.E1 — binds the request, the subject and the report; nothing else discharges.
AnswerAction.title: AnswerAction

Batch.description: §5.B3 — the materialized transition; replay folds these and never calls ``decide``.
Batch.title: Batch

Charge.description: §6.G1 — recorded once per subject on its first complete accepted answer.
Charge.title: Charge

ClassifyFindingAction.description: §6.F5 — assigns a known priority; ``unknown`` is not a classification.
ClassifyFindingAction.title: ClassifyFindingAction

Command.description: §5.B1-B2: the admitted command as recorded in the batch.
Command.title: Command

Effect.description: §8.1 — an outbox row with its own id; ``target`` follows the §8.1 grammar.
Effect.title: Effect

EffectKind.description: §8.1: refresh targets re-render from ``read()``; actionable targets check applicability.
EffectKind.title: EffectKind

ExplicitHold.description: §6.G3: exhaustion, owner_decision, unanswerable and operator release only explicitly.
ExplicitHold.title: ExplicitHold

ExternalFinding.description: No fingerprint, falsifier or evidence is invented for Codex; provenance is the comment.
ExternalFinding.title: ExternalFinding

FindingAnswer.description: §2.3: one per finding the request named.
FindingAnswer.title: FindingAnswer

FindingAnswerKind.description: §2.3 ``FindingAnswer.answer`` — the closure reviewer's word on a named finding.
FindingAnswerKind.title: FindingAnswerKind

FindingPriority.description: §3.5 / §6.F5: ``unknown`` is admitted, visible and blocking until classified.
FindingPriority.title: FindingPriority

FollowUpResolutionRequest.description: §6.F3 — the ticket id is format-checked here; Linear I/O stays out of the transaction.
FollowUpResolutionRequest.title: FollowUpResolutionRequest

GrantRoundsAction.description: §6.G1 — changes the allowance, not history; closes an open episode (§G4).
GrantRoundsAction.title: GrantRoundsAction

Lifecycle.description: §6.C3: closed pauses, reopened resumes, merged is terminal.
Lifecycle.title: Lifecycle

NormalizedResult.description: §2.3 — the one interpretation of both report arms.
NormalizedResult.title: NormalizedResult

ObservePRAction.description:
§6.C1 — a whole-state observation; the reducer derives each consequence independently.

``exemption`` is the §6.C6 evidence the reconcile run computed for ``subject`` (``null``
when no rule applies); the reducer records it on a subject change and never recomputes it.
ObservePRAction.title: ObservePRAction

Observed.description: §3.3 metadata refreshed by observation; ``mergeable`` is GitHub's tri-state (§6.D8).
Observed.title: Observed

OpenRequestAction.description: §3.4 / §6.D. The obligation's kind is ``request_kind`` (``kind`` names the verb).
OpenRequestAction.title: OpenRequestAction

Policy.description: §9.2 — versioned per repository; a Review keeps the version it opened under (§6.I).
Policy.title: Policy

ProjectionHandles.description: §8.1 handles the projections edit in place.
ProjectionHandles.title: ProjectionHandles

Receipt.description: §4. ``review_id`` is null when the refusal precedes the Review's existence.
Receipt.title: Receipt

Refusal.description: What ``decide`` returns instead of a batch (§5.B3).
Refusal.title: Refusal

RefusalCode.description: §4 Receipt — the closed set of refusal codes.
RefusalCode.title: RefusalCode

RefusedOutcome.description: §5.B4 — appended to ``review_attempts``; ``state`` is null before the Review exists.
RefusedOutcome.title: RefusedOutcome

ReplayedOutcome.description: §5.B2 — the act id was already admitted; nothing changed.
ReplayedOutcome.title: ReplayedOutcome

Request.description:
§3.4 — an obligation. ``names`` is non-empty only for closure/appeal (reducer-checked).

``transport`` holds the references the publisher records after a dispatch (§6.D5);
``retransports`` holds the instants at which §6.D6 housekeeping queued one more transport
effect — its length is the count the policy's ``transport_bound`` bounds.
Request.title: Request

RequestRetransported.description: §6.D6 — housekeeping queued one more transport effect for a stalled request.
RequestRetransported.title: RequestRetransported

ResolutionKind.description: §6.F3 — the closed set of ways a finding leaves the standing set.
ResolutionKind.title: ResolutionKind

Review.description: §3.3 — the durable record. ``review_batches`` is the truth; this is its fold (§5.B3).
Review.title: Review

ReviewKey.description: §3.1: GitHub's stable ids; ``owner/repo#n`` is display only.
ReviewKey.title: ReviewKey

RoutingByRound.description: §6.D2 (KRA-1131): Codex holds round one; the substitute every later round.
RoutingByRound.title: RoutingByRound

SameAsResolutionRequest.description: §6.F2 — an explicit link; contests the other finding's resolution if it has one.
SameAsResolutionRequest.title: SameAsResolutionRequest

SlackPolicy.description: Where system-origin deliveries and the board line go.
SlackPolicy.title: SlackPolicy

SourceRecordKind.description: §7 source records: GitHub reviews, review comments, issue comments.
SourceRecordKind.title: SourceRecordKind

SourceRef.description: §7: a GitHub record by kind, id and version (``updated_at``/``submitted_at``).
SourceRef.title: SourceRef

SubjectClearableHold.description: §6.G3: only ``human_gate`` and ``stack`` may release on subject change.
SubjectClearableHold.title: SubjectClearableHold

Testimony.description: §3.4 / §6.G5 — the retrospective's answer names its deliverable.
Testimony.title: Testimony

Unavailable.description: §6.D3 — a recorded condition with a clearing rule, never a bare flag.
Unavailable.title: Unavailable
